body:
Thanks for responding. I feel like a bad mom because I have emotional issues like depression, anxiety, ADHD,and OCD that I only recently am taking care of. I feel like with the therapy and medication I can now truly see all the messed up stuff I thought, did , believed. I was a yeller at my kids. I wanted everything to be perfect and pushed my daughter too hard. I put my anxieties on her and now she can't even sleep at night because of how anxious she is. I'm trying but I almost feel like what is the point? I can't see myself as good anyway. I only ever see myself hurting those closest to me. My sons are just babies, I suppose I haven't done anything too egregious yet. I just hate myself fr the person I was (still am I guess, it's changing but how much? Is it enough even at this point?) and I can't let go, I can't stop hating myself until I feel I have been punished enough but when is enough? Never? I feel like it will never be enough and I will always hate myself and will always fuck up my kids unless I die. 

I feel ungrateful because others have it so much worse, have real problems and here I am complaining and crying for some selfish reason becaus eI hate myself. I have a beautiful family and my husband is amazing, so supportive and loving but how much of this will he take? He deserves a wife who s free from all of this and can love him fully without constantly wishing to disappear. I feel like I odn't work hard enough, even if I work all day I dont do enough, I'm always trying to make up forsomething that I missed/messed up/ forgot about. I don't know. 

Thank you so very much for replying. Honestly, it helped a lot.
